name: PBQtah 4 2022
information: Everyone is welcome but remember that this competition does not have events like 2x2, 3x3 and 4x4. It consists of the blindfolded events and FMC. Competition fees will cover waffles for breakfast and pizza for lunch, if you have any dietary restrictions please let us know while registering so we can do our best to accomodate you. The competition venue is a private residence located in Saratoga Springs, competitors will be informed of the address after registration closes.
